## What the update is about, in words.
##
## Written by hand on 2026-10-06 from the official patch notes of the release
## (hub.realmofthemadgod.com/news0/updates0/s31notes1), then checked against
## the client of the same day. No amount of reading the client tells you why
## anything was added. Everything else on the What's New page is generated by
## comparing two clients; this file is the one part of it that is editorial,
## and it is dated and signed for exactly that reason.
##
## Format: one fact per line, kind|text. A "part" opens a story and every line
## after it belongs to that story until the next one:
##   blurb|the line under its title
##   point|a paragraph of prose
##   show|kind|what   a block the page draws, in the order given:
##     things|Name::caption; Name          the things, by their client name
##     pairs|Before>After; Before>After    what became what
##     cards|figure::heading::text;; ...   side by side; the figure may be empty
##     steps|first;; then;; last           one thing after another
##     scores|Name:15,50,85; Name:40       where in a realm's run it turns up
##     week|dates|Dungeon::modifier::shinies|Dungeon::modifier::shinies
##     list|heading|a; b; c                names to read; a heading "Over" strikes them
##     checks|a;; b                        a short checklist
##     set|Set name                        a set from the Index: skin, pieces, bonus
##     crucible, ritual, places            the season's modes; the portals below
## A place line says what a portal opens on, as the notes tell it - the client
## does not: place|portal|who is inside|what it pays.

title|Twilight of the Mad God
subtitle|Season 31, Part 1 — Halloween
date|2026-10-06
lede|The Time Chamber closes and the Nexus dresses for Halloween. Memories — short, lore-driven solo dungeons — bring the first Heirlooms; two Druid sets and a basket of SweetTreats join them, and event Shinies finally reach regular characters. The Blood Ritual, the Infested Castle, Totalia and the Zombie Hordes return for four weeks.

place|Stoneborn Memory Portal|The Red and the Purple Stone Guardian, taking turns. Each one beaten throws its blade into the arena, a hazard for the rest of the fight.|A blueprint toward the Stoneborn Husk, guaranteed
place|Infected Memory Portal|The Founder, in a guild hall that is no longer yours, leading an infected horde against the Nexus's old heroes.|A blueprint toward the Teratoma, guaranteed

part|Memories and Heirlooms
blurb|Short solo dungeons, and the new kind of UT they pay out.
show|places
point|Memories are short, lore-driven solo dungeons, part of the core game from now on. They drop as solo keys you open from your vault; how to come by one is left for players to find.
show|things|Teratoma::the infected orb;Stoneborn Husk::the heavy armour
point|An Heirloom is a UT built to carry a build, crafted from three other UTs once you hold its blueprint — as many times as you have the materials. Strong enough that wearing two of them costs you:
show|set|Heirlooms
point|The client already counts seven Heirlooms in that set; these two are the first.

part|Pumpkin Shrine Groove
blurb|The season's first Battle Pass, from 6 October to 3 November.
show|skins|Hollow Harvest Huntress::to stay with the fall;Lantern Shade Trickster::or to have more fun
point|Free rewards at every milestone, more with Battle Pass Exalt: bloody snacks, Halloween skins, and Halloween ST sets and items to open the season with.

part|Celestial Stones and quests
blurb|A Masquerade Archer for sixty stones, and a quest list rebuilt.
show|skins|Gothic Masquerade Archer::60 Celestial Stones, at the Tinkerer
point|Stones come from the Battle Pass and the Celestial Stones Mystery Box. The Tinkerer's quests can be done once per account.
show|list|New this season|Exquisite Masquerade Archer; Exquisite Voodoo Bat Pet Stone; Voodoo Witcher Assassin; Voodoo Queen Mystic; Pumpkin Head Warrior; Ghostly Archer; Vampire King Kensei; Haunted Skull Necromancer; Vampire Bat Pet Stone; Cursed Raven Pet Stone; Spider Rider Mystic; Voodoo Witch Necromancer; Witch Doctor Wizard

part|Queen Tiramisu
blurb|The Community Manager's own skin: won, never sold.
show|skins|Tiramisu Queen Mystic::as the client calls it
show|cards|9 winners::Caption contest::A screenshot on the official socials, sometime this season. The nine favourite captions win.;;10 winners::Drawing contest::Anything RotMG with a costume or dress-up theme, in MS Paint. Five chosen, five drawn at random; the date comes on Discord.;;Last one standing::Surprise arenas::Twenty-five players, at random moments. Enemies may not behave as usual, and a death there is final.
point|Few of these skins will ever exist. A hint may drop in the Discord's #rotmg channel before an arena opens — and no support ticket brings an arena character back.

part|Crucible and Blood Ritual
blurb|One modifier for the season, and the Ritual's trade, back again.
show|crucible
point|The Crucible holds for the whole season; apply at its NPC in the Nexus. It gives vitality and wisdom and takes a third of the healing you receive from anything but yourself.
show|ritual
point|Each step of the Ritual trades health for damage, or damage for health. Only giving health up pays in loot.

part|Whispers of Skuld
blurb|The season's mission tree — where most of the Halloween gear is earned.
point|Whispers of Skuld is the mission tree of this season: missions to complete, each paying its reward. These are the rewards the notes name.
show|group|The new Halloween gear|Sweettreats Sword;Sweettreats Dagger;Sweettreats Bow;Sweettreats Wand;Sweettreats Katana;Sweettreats Staff;Sweettreats Ring
show|group|The Druid's ST reskin, in its own Druid missions|Aeonic Talon;Jurassic Sigil;Primal Padding;Storied Fossil
show|group|The Halloween costumes of past years|Red Riding Dress;Holy Order's Habit;Bachelor's Tuxedo;Haori of the Wind;Platinum Segmentata;Big Bad Fursuit
show|group|Three of the new emotes|Flame Skull (emote);Sad Ghost Bride (emote);Drooling Horseman (emote)
point|The older Halloween UTs and their ST reskins are in the tree too, with the older cosmetics; the notes do not list which.

part|Shinies for everyone
blurb|Event Shinies, open to regular characters at last.
show|things|Flowering Kimono::Shiny;Sage's Wakibiki::Shiny;Ethereal Happi::Shiny;Overwhelming Axehead::Shiny;Draconic Insignia::Shiny;Irradiance Sheath::Shiny
point|Six new Shinies arrive with the season. For this event, the weekly event chests drop every older Shiny of their dungeon to every character, seasonal or not.
point|The lasting change follows: Shinies dropping for regular characters from their own boss or entity, released in batches, oldest first. Shinies of the current season stay out of the event chests.

part|The Infested Castle
blurb|The realm closes, the earth shakes, and Oryx's Castle is infested.
show|steps|Close the realm and fight Oryx's quest monsters;;Two minutes later, an earthquake;;Everyone lands in the Infested Oryx's Castle;;Barrels open the way — the only way through the Stone Guardians and Oryx
point|The barrel is the Parasite Chamber's mechanic. Oryx 2 drops the Halloween event white reskins, at a low chance; Oryx 1 drops the Tome of Holy Furor, as every year.
show|things|Tome of Holy Furor::from Oryx 1

part|Costumes in the realm
blurb|Quest monsters in Halloween dress — and the reskins they drop.
show|pairs|Grand Sphinx>Withered Sphinx;Hermit God>Reanimated Hermit God;Ghost Ship>The Flying Dutchman;Jade Statue>Blue Oni;Garnet Statue>Red Oni;Skull Shrine>Pumpkin Shrine
point|The Cube God wears a costume too. Each of these reskins now drops from its encounter, alongside the original:
show|things|Helm of the Jack-o'-naut;Spooky Smasher;Cloak of Eerie Trepidation;Phantasm Dirk;Trap of the Blood Spirit;Orb of Terror;Longbow of Spirits and Shadows;Shield of Jawgmur;Kagebooshi

part|Returning encounters
blurb|Totalia, the Zombie Horde and the candy piles.
show|scores|Totalia the Malevolent:15,50,85;Zombie Horde:40,60,80
point|Totalia haunts the Haunted Hallows, and once each Ship Wreck and Dead Church. She drops the previous Halloween UTs and costumes, a chance at the SweetTreats weapons and Ring, and her four emotes.
point|The Zombie Hordes keep to the Haunted Hallows. Among your zombie counterparts, Bonegrind the Undead Butcher drops T11 weapon reskins and a chance at the Infected Assassin skin.
show|things|Bonegrind the Undead Butcher;Infected Assassin Skin;Soul Collector Engraving
point|Candy piles spawn by themselves in Adept and Veteran biomes: old Halloween UTs, consumables, cloths and costumes, stat pots and candies, the Soul Collector Engraving, and their biome's own UTs.

part|SweetTreats
blurb|Six sweet weapons, a ring to bind them, and the costumes.
show|things|Sweettreats Sword::reskins the Pirate King's Cutlass;Sweettreats Dagger::the Corruption Cutter;Sweettreats Bow::the Spider Silk Bow;Sweettreats Wand::the Wand of the Fallen;Sweettreats Katana::the Celestial Blade;Sweettreats Staff::the Staff of Esben;Sweettreats Ring::the new ring
point|Wear the Sweettreats Ring with any of the six and a Halloween armour, and the set wakes. They come from event chests, missions and Totalia.
show|set|Sweettreats Set|bonus
point|The Halloween costumes return from Totalia and the realm's candies, and as mission rewards:
show|things|Red Riding Dress;Holy Order's Habit;Bachelor's Tuxedo;Haori of the Wind;Platinum Segmentata;Big Bad Fursuit

part|Druid sets
blurb|The Swamp Hermit and the Skeletosaur — and a third the notes leave out.
show|set|Swamp Hermit Druid Set
point|Pulsating Wand — shots that swell and shrink, fast, and bleed whatever they touch. Swampy Sigil — become a swamp monster with Berserk and dexterity, healed as you cast.
point|Mossy Guard — instant healing on the first hit taken from full health. Willow Sprout — health from your dexterity bonus: an HP ring for any class.
show|set|Skeletosaur Druid Set
point|The Skeletosaur reawakens the Mechanical Raptor set's ancient model. Both come from the Druid missions and the event chests.
show|set|Extra Dimensional Druid Set
point|The client also carries this Extra Dimensional set, which the patch notes do not mention.

part|Emotes and cosmetics
blurb|Six horrific emotes, and a pack for the shop.
show|things|Flame Skull (emote);Sad Ghost Bride (emote);Drooling Horseman (emote);Judgmental Beholder (emote);Cheeky Possessed Pumpkin (emote);Handsome Ruthven (emote)
point|The first three are mission rewards; the Loot Broom drops the other three.
show|things|Soul-Fire Arrival::player entrance;Hollow Key Keeper Pet Skin;Grave Bell Poltergeist Pet Skin;Masquerade of the Departed Grave Unlocker::gravestone
point|The cosmetics pack stays in the shop for the season.

part|Weekly rotation
blurb|Four weeks of event dungeons, each with its modifier and its Shinies.
show|week|6 – 13 October|High Tech Terror::Experienced · +100% XP::B.O.W., S.T.A.F.F., Q.U.I.V.E.R., S.H.E.A.T.H., E.Y.E.|Fungal Cavern & Crystal Cavern::Powered Up · the Dwarf Miner's drill starts fully charged::Ring of Decades, Fungal Breastplate, Crystallized Worm Spellblade, Crystal Shield, Sporous Spray Spell, Tome of the Mushroom Tribes, Cave Dweller Trap, Fractal Blades, Cloak of Reflection, Fractured Gemstone Wakizashi, Star of Enlightenment, Crystalline Sigil
show|week|13 – 20 October|Infernal Abyss of Demons::Found Treasure · treasure rooms revealed::Demon Blade, Volcanic Sheath, Berserker's Breastplate, Adamantine Helm|Plagued Nest::Dust Storm · +50% dust::Queen's Stinger, Swarmlord's Sigil, Green Beehemoth Quiver, Hivemaster Helm, Beekeeper's Flamethrower
show|week|20 – 27 October|Heroic Undead Lair::Found Treasure · treasure rooms revealed::Doom Bow, Spectral Sword, Wandering Souls Spell, Ring of Skeletal Specters|Advanced Kogbold Steamworks::Steamworks Maintenance · turrets disabled::Overclocking Amulet, Steam Pipe, Chain Dagger, Laser Pointer, Scepter of Rust, Brain Cube, Kogbold Multitool, Kogbold Enhancement Core
show|week|27 October – 3 November|Haunted Cemetery::Looting · +50% loot, and the Pumpkin Master as the last boss::Soul's Guidance, Plague Poison, Resurrected Warrior's Armor|Spectral Penitentiary::Rewarding · +25% XP, loot and dust::Tools of the Tarnished, Wretched Rags, Cackling Straitjacket, Ocular Entrapment, Motivational Megaphone, Damnation, Vial of Soul Extract
point|Every event chest can hold the SweetTreats weapons, the new Druid reskin set, and — in the second dungeon of each week — the Sweettreats Ring.

part|Loot Brooms
blurb|A harmless enemy that pays, in every event dungeon.
show|things|Loot Broom::in a room, or after the boss
point|Catch it. It drops the Halloween reskin UTs of 2025:
show|things|The Crimson Blade;Blood Coated Dirk;Ceremonial Wand;Blood Siphoning Katana;Scarlet Etched Branch;Occult Bow;Sacramental Crossbow;Scepter of the Transgressor;Esoteric Buckler::also from Janus the Doorwarden;Blood Ritual Tools;The Hemomancer's Ring
show|list|And|Halloween ST crates — Demon Pumpkin, Witch's Skull, Haunted Tombstone, Cursed Grimoire, Eerie Music Box, Silver Urn; Halloween consumables and cloths; new and old Halloween emotes, Jack O Lantern and Lit O Lantern among them; a Mystery Stat Pot

part|Fixes
blurb|Five repairs that came with the release.
show|checks|Hovering over Command Cornea no longer causes an error;;The Forge buff now applies to the Demon Lord's Skull;;The Venerable Doom Bow's arrow no longer flies backwards;;The first section of the tutorial dungeon has its text again;;The Teratoma has its stat-modifier enchantment label
